Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Leelawati Kumari, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Pramod Kumar Pandey, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 18-12-2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. Issue notice upon the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc., must be filed on or before 05.01.2024 failing which this application shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.
3. Put up this case on 04.03.2024.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the meantime, the order dated 26.09.2018, passed by learned SDJM, Sherghati, Gaya in Criminal Complaint No. 388 of 2018 Tr. No. 1671 of 2019, whereby cognizance of offences under Sections 147, 323, 379, 498A and 34 of the IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 has been taken, shall remain stayed.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are married sister-in-law,
mother-in-law and brothers-in-law of the O.P. No. 02.
It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
